impact: Korean memory names are trading cautiously into Nvidia's report; weakness in SK hynix and Samsung tends to spill over to MU, DRAM and SNXX at the US open.
summary: The Kospi opened 0.28% higher Monday then turned lower, at 5,286.32 by 9:15 a.m., with SK hynix down 1.4% and Samsung flat as traders wait for Nvidia earnings and the Anthropic IPO.
title: Kospi reverses lower after flat open, SK hynix slips ahead of Nvidia
